claims.verbatim:
Steamship United Kingdom (Br), Macdonald, Glasgow May
19, with mdse and 477 passengers (all well), to Francis Mac
donald & Co. May 28, lat 44 10, lon 49, spoke ship Eliza &
Mary, bound W; 30th, lat 43 40, lon 56 10, bark Cerila[?], stand-
ing SW; June 3, at 9:30 AM, lat 40 30, lon 70 55, steamship
Britannia, bound E. Was detained off Sandy Hook lightship
twelve hours by fog.
